snippet.title: Romance RPG - A Courting of Curses - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play as your own villainess in this 3D romance RPG! Romance four mysterious suitors that bring survival or destruction. Live your life in a Magical Academy, trapped in a day/night cycle: study, socialise, and fight for your life—then do it all over again.

Game page now up on Steam!
